text: For a few months I had paranoid thoughts in groups, especially when people laughed. I'd feel they were judging me. I avoided parties. The feeling slowly faded but I still get it sometimes when I'm tired.

Ich hatte monatelang das Gefühl, dass ich nicht wirklich existiere. Die Fragen, die mich im Trip gequält haben, sind immer wieder zurückgekommen, oft nachts, und ich konnte sie nicht abschalten. Ich hatte Angst, verrückt zu werden. Ich war depressiv und habe mich von allem zurückgezogen. Erst nach etwa einem Jahr wurde es besser.

The main thing that stayed is the feeling that I'm living someone else's life. It's like a background hum. Most days it's quiet, but on bad days it's loud. I'll be doing something ordinary, cooking, sitting in a meeting, and suddenly I'll feel that I'm an impostor in my own body, that 'he' is somewhere else and I've taken his place. When it's strong, I can't feel any connection to my memories. My childhood photos look like someone else's.

In the first year it was constant. I couldn't work properly. I'm a software developer and I couldn't concentrate on code because I kept drifting into this unreal state. I took several months of sick leave.

I also developed a strong fear of fire, full moons and masks. Halloween is a nightmare. I can't sit around a campfire. When I see a full moon I feel a jolt of dread.

I had panic attacks, especially in the first months, often at night, where I'd wake up not knowing who I was. I'd have to turn on the light and look at my ID card, like that night. I still keep it on my bedside table.

I became depressed, mainly because I felt I'd lost myself and didn't know if I'd ever get myself back. I withdrew from friends. I stopped doing things I loved, like playing in a band, because I couldn't feel the music anymore.

Over the years it's improved. But it's never fully gone.
Avoided weddings and big parties for a year. Got anxious on dance floors.

Ich hatte danach lange Zeit Angst um meinen Partner und habe ihn ständig beobachtet, ob es ihm gut geht. Ich habe schlecht geschlafen. Unsere Beziehung war in dieser Zeit sehr angespannt. Erst als er von sich aus eine Therapie gemacht hat, konnte ich mich etwas entspannen.

It took me a long time to understand what had happened. For months I felt confused and guilty, as if I had done something wrong. I kept going to her sessions because I didn't know how to stop. Eventually I stopped. Then I had nightmares about her hands on my face. I couldn't trust any therapist or doctor. I felt as if my mind had been violated, and I didn't have words for it. I became depressed and very isolated. I also had periods of depersonalisation where I felt my mind wasn't my own.
Scars on my arms. For a few months I'd sometimes feel the crawling sensation again, especially at night, and it would send me into a panic. That faded. I avoid research chemicals now.
Nothing lasting. I set up two-factor authentication and laughed about it later.

Ich hatte lange Zeit Albträume, in denen ich ihn im Licht der Handylampe sehe. Ich konnte keine Berghütten mehr betreten und bin nicht mehr wandern gegangen. Ich habe mir große Vorwürfe gemacht, weil wir alle unter Drogen standen und deshalb langsamer reagiert haben. Ich habe mich auch ein Stück weit von der Gruppe entfernt, weil die Treffen immer wieder die Erinnerung geweckt haben. Monatelang war ich niedergeschlagen.

I couldn't go back to work in the ICU. The first time I walked onto the ward after the retreat, the sound of the monitors made me freeze and I had a panic attack in the staff toilet. I tried for two more weeks and then went on sick leave. I've since moved to an outpatient clinic.

I have flashbacks of my mother on the ventilator, which never happened, and of the rows of patients turning their heads. These came daily at first. They're still frequent. The smell of tobacco smoke triggers me, and so does the smell of woodsmoke, which is horrible because I used to love it.

For a long time I had a strong sense of guilt about the patients who died, as if the vision had shown me the truth that I failed them. I know this isn't rational. I was an ICU nurse during a pandemic. But the feeling of being judged by the dead stayed.

I became severely depressed. For about four months I had suicidal thoughts, and the thought that came in the ceremony, that dying would make it stop, kept coming back. I didn't act on it, but I was scared of myself.

I also felt deeply ashamed about biting someone and fighting. I'm normally a very calm person.

Physically I had trouble breathing at times, a feeling of my lungs being heavy, especially at night. My GP checked my lungs, which were fine.

My grief for my mother got tangled up with all of this. I still can't think of her without the image of the tube.
Ein paar Wochen lang habe ich Spiegel gemieden, dann war es wieder gut.
